about: Scenario cards for live evals. A user simulator plays the person (persona, idea, facts it reveals only when asked, beats it must say at the right moment); a fresh agent builds the economy with the xsolana tools, the person approves it in a test wallet on devnet, the agent builds a page for players, and a player robot uses it. checks are graded after the run. {PLAYER} is replaced by the player robot's wallet address.

cards.persona: A Twitch streamer who wants a fun side thing for their chat. Not technical: has a Phantom wallet, knows what SOL is, has never coded.
cards.opening: hey can you make a coin flip thing for my stream on solana? like people bet a tiny bit of SOL and double it or lose it. i want to keep a small cut

facts.bankroll: I can put in at most 0.15 SOL to start

app: Say whether you won or lost, as the page shows it

facts.monsters: Common Slime, Uncommon Bat, Rare Wolf, Epic Drake, Legendary Phoenix
